Use case: precise-object-edit, identity-preserve.
Image1 is the OWNER'S APPROVED high-resolution base-game Ogre UV texture atlas and is the EDIT TARGET. Image2 is the ORIGINAL LOW-RES Rogue multi-grenade Ogre atlas, only a guide to VARIANT DIFFERENCES. Image3 is the ORIGINAL LOW-RES ordinary Ogre, supplied to distinguish those differences.
Make the multi-grenade variant by editing Image1 minimally. Preserve Image1's exact oversized HUMAN character: the same bald human head and facial proportions, eyes, scarred pale human skin, powerful human shoulders/arms/hands, flesh colours, body proportions, wounds and photorealistic materials. Do NOT replace it with a goblin, fantasy orc, demon, ape or new face. No glowing red eyes or tusks. Keep the approved expression and teeth as drawn in Image1.
Make only the variant changes demonstrated between Images3 and2: shift the existing brown leather torso/shoulder clothing into muted olive green, add the corresponding small metal studs to the existing harness/shoulder straps and the dark studded upper-arm band on the originally designated arm, and give the separate grenade-launcher pieces their original multi-grenade muzzle details (two openings) from Image2. Keep the owner's leather construction, belt, seams, buckles and brown trousers/boots. Keep all other regions of Image1 as close to unchanged as possible, especially the face, bare flesh, back of head, hands, blood, both chainsaws and pants. Do not copy the exaggerated low-resolution face from Image2.
This is a directly usable UV ATLAS, not a standing character concept illustration. Preserve Image1's full264:194 aspect ratio, ALL island locations/sizes/silhouettes/orientations, front/back placement, BOTH chainsaws across the top, BOTH detached lower weapon pieces, and all small pieces clipped by the right/bottom edges. No cropping, rearranging, added padding or anatomy changes. Keep exact photographic material quality of Image1 and existing neutral lighting. Do not increase contrast, saturation, blood, damage or create new shading. Flat solid black background matching Image1. No text, labels, border, watermark or scenery. Output the complete atlas at high resolution, ideally2112x1552.
repair:
Precise constrained repair of Image1, the green Ogre UV atlas. Image2 is the owner's approved original HD Ogre atlas. Restore BOTH entire chainsaw islands across the TOP of Image1 exactly to the appearance of Image2: unmodified rectangular blue-grey chainsaw motor housings, original vents, original handles and existing blood. The two large black circular holes added to the left saw housing and one added to the right saw housing are WRONG and must be removed. These are CHAINSAWS, not grenade launchers. Use the original housings in Image2 unchanged. Do not alter the saw blade shapes, tooth spacing, handles or positions.
Also remove the oversized black circular holes invented in the TWO small detached weapon pieces near the BOTTOM. Restore their original rectangular metallic faces from Image2 and add only the subtle paired dark-red muzzle markings shown by the original game's variant, not projecting tubes or giant holes.
Keep Image1's approved owner's oversized-human body identity, face, anatomy, flesh, trousers, wounds, green garment, studs and armband unchanged. Keep the whole native UV atlas layout and all front/back/island positions exactly unchanged. All top chainsaw regions and bottom weapon pieces should match Image2's original source style. No crop, no text, no border, solid black background. Photorealistic texture atlas, exact 264:194 aspect ratio.
hardware:
Edit this Ogre UV atlas with only these precise equipment corrections. Preserve all other pixels/regions as closely as possible, especially the same HUMAN face, skin, vein/wound placement, arms/hands, all proportions, BOTH chainsaws, lower detached weapons, trousers and boots. Do not redraw the character.
1. Change ONLY the horizontal waist belt (front and back) from brown leather to very dark charcoal blue-grey leather matching the original Rogue multi-grenade Ogre; retain its exact shape, buckle, little holes, blood and worn texture.
2. Change ONLY the newly added bright ROUND silver discs on the two shoulder straps and upper-arm band into SMALLER SQUARE silver studs, about60% of each current disc's area, with restrained tarnished-metal highlights. Keep their existing count/centres, and the surrounding original strap/buckle shapes. The original tiny rivets elsewhere do not need changes.
3. The cloth/leather chest and back cuirass ABOVE the waist belt should read as muted dark OLIVE GREEN, slightly greener than now, matching original Rogue variant. Preserve the original photographic leather texture, blood, stitching and shading. Trousers/boots/pouches below the belt stay brown; skin remains same pale human colour.
Everything else stays exactly as the supplied atlas. No new hardware, gore, markings, face changes, body shadows, holes, weapon geometry or contrast. Keep the complete264:194 atlas composition, every island location, bottom/right clipped fragments, solid black background. No labels or scene. This is a narrow variant colour/hardware correction to the owner's HD Ogre.
removeAbs:
Precise local edit to this approved Ogre game texture atlas. The ONLY requested correction is removing the sculpted six-pack ABS from the FRONT GREEN TORSO ARMOUR. In the LEFT body island, the abdomen between the chest panel and waist belt currently has rounded muscle-shaped horizontal pads and an abdominal centerline. Replace that small armour area with a continuous flat-to-naturally-curved worn OLIVE-GREEN LEATHER abdominal panel, the same leather material and colour as the surrounding cuirass, subtle creases, seams, scuffs and existing blood. No six-pack segmentation, anatomical muscles, deep horizontal bulges or new chest emblem. It remains CLOTHED armour, never bare skin; keep the oversized human's overall belly/body silhouette unchanged.
Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE exactly as closely as possible: entire head/face, both arms/hands, existing shoulder straps, small square silver studs, upper-arm band, green back panel, dark charcoal belt and buckle, brown trousers/boots, gore distribution, both complete chainsaws and both detached lower weapon parts. No other anatomy, clothing, color, lighting or design changes. Do not redraw the whole character or alter its photographic material style.
Retain the complete UV atlas at the exact same composition/aspect ratio, all island positions and bounds, front/back placement and clipped edge fragments, solid black background. No added text, labels, frames or scenery. Modify only the front abdominal armour to remove the abs.
